game_stress.build: native MSVC dev: workspace opt-level1, dependencies opt-level3
game_stress.scope: Existing Growing Guns stress fixture, full graphics, native output, 4 identical overhead views, no HUD/audio/presentation. GPU timings are measured scopes, not displayed FPS. CPU times are dev-profile observations.

4k.allocation: Shared 6.75 MiB smoke asset is primed before measurements; cold first-explosion upload is excluded.
4k.baked_volume_counts: Expected from current source rule, not observed/read back. Counts above16 retain other explosion effects but recycle old smoke volumes.

layout_notes.inside: All explosions share one centre; four cameras sit within the default 6.5m-radius smoke box. Larger --radius overrides may also contain cameras in other layouts.
layout_notes.overlap: All explosions share one centre; cameras outside default-radius volumes.
layout_notes.spread: Centres are 5m apart on a centred grid; cameras stay outside default-radius volumes.

4k.reconstruction: native HDR, no TAA or spatial upscaler
4k.scope: GPU root-pass timestamps in static floor-only fixture using full Effects.explosion recipe and its local lights; excludes gameplay simulation, destruction, crowd, UI, startup, upload and image readback. Not gameplay FPS.
4k.timing_aggregation: Only FX root-scope GPU timestamps are retained here; already summed across all views. Not whole-frame time or presented FPS.
